description.fun: Clauncher's oversized right claw throws it off balance, so instead of swimming straight it jets around by firing blasts of water from the claw, powered by gas it releases inside its body. The same water gun shoots flying prey out of the air and shatters rock at close range. Its claws sometimes drop off and grow back, and in Galar and Paldea they're a popular delicacy.
description.guide: Clauncher is a Water-type Pokémon from Kalos based on the pistol shrimp. It moves and hunts by shooting jets of compressed water from its large right claw. Its claw meat is eaten as a delicacy in some regions.
description.tagline: A lopsided shrimp that gets around by firing its claw

description.fun: Clawitzer's claw is bigger than the rest of it: it sucks up seawater and fires it as cannonballs that can punch through a tanker's hull. Blasting water out of a nozzle on its back, it can rocket along at 60 knots, and feelers on the claw track down prey. Its name is a claw crossed with a howitzer, and its Japanese name, Bloster, is an anagram of 'lobster'.
description.guide: Clawitzer is a Water-type Pokémon that evolves from Clauncher. Its huge claw fires compressed water powerful enough to pierce ship hulls, and jets of water from its back let it travel at high speed. It is territorial and fights fiercely with others of its kind.
description.tagline: A shrimp with a howitzer for a hand
